title: This Week in South Florida: Jobs, Rivalry Football, Vice City and a $1.7B Groundbreaking
igCaption:
South Florida has a two-day hospitality and tourism job fair in Palm Beach County, a Miami FSU kickoff set for 7 p.m. on ESPN, and a Heat Vice City night tied to GTA VI.
A Mandarin Oriental condo project also broke ground in Miami after reaching $1.7B in sales.
Which one are you watching this week?

Sources: WPTV, Sports Business Journal, news-press.com, Tallahassee Democrat, The Business Journals, Wikipedia Hard Rock Stadium, Wikipedia Miami Heat, Wikipedia Palm Beach County, Florida

#SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents #MiamiSports #PalmBeachCounty

Palm Beach County hosts a two-day hospitality and tourism job fair in Lake Worth Beach and Greenacres. The county had 1,492,191 residents in 2020.
